title: Scrape loop goroutine hangs forever and never exits on context cancellation when a forced/scrape error send blocks on...

source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus PR #17554; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: Scrape loop goroutine hangs forever and never exits on context cancellation when a forced/scrape error send blocks on an unreceived errc channel.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the scrape package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: In scrapeAndReport the forced-error and scrape-error sends on errc are unguarded blocking sends, so a context cancellation while no receiver is reading leaks the scrape loop goroutine.

ops_fault.description: Scrape loop goroutines accumulate and fail to terminate after their context is cancelled, because an error report blocks on a channel with no receiver.
detection_keywords: scrape loop never exits on context cancellation
localization_keywords: context cancellation cannot interrupt the channel send
repair_keywords: wrap errc send in a select
add case <-sl.ctx.Done() to unblock the send
select between errc <- err and ctx cancellation
let context cancellation abort the error report

visible_context.issue_text: When a scrape target's context is cancelled, the scrape loop goroutine can hang forever instead of exiting. Over time these stuck goroutines accumulate.
error_logs: goroutine leak detected: scrape loop failed to exit on context cancellation
goroutine stuck on chan send in scrape.(*scrapeLoop).scrapeAndReport
scrape loop goroutine count steadily increasing after target reloads
visible_context.notes: Real upstream regression; diagnosis injected as upstream ops context.
